messages:
maya: Quick sync — final pass on tri-mode landing copy (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Need: hero variants, 2 webinar hooks, benchmark blurbs, and inbound lead routing for SDR handoff. Can we close this today?

devon: yep. I sketched 3 hero lines for tone test. dropping them here.

sam: paste them pls — will sanity check against product claims.

devon: 1) 'Ship LLM features that hit predictable latency and cost.'
2) 'Same API. Any scale. Your data, your controls.'
3) 'From dev to production: inference that stays fast and cheap.'

lee: I like 2 for Private page, 1 for Hosted hero, 3 for Dedicated. Visuals: 2 should show VPC padlock, 1 shows quick results spinner.

maya: good directional. Want microcopy variants for CTA too:
- Hosted CTA: "Try Hosted API — free credits"
- Dedicated CTA: "Reserve Dedicated capacity"
- Private CTA: "Talk to sales for VPC/on-prem"

devon: added two webinar hooks to pair with benchmarking narrative:
- Hook A (tech benchmark): "Live: how we shave 40% token cost across workloads — demo + perf deep-dive"
- Hook B (customer stories): "Workshop: migrating inference to Dedicated and keeping latency SLOs"

sam: For benchmarks copy — keep it honest and quantifiable. Suggested blurb for marketing site: "Benchmarked across popular open models: average tail latency under 300ms at 95th percentile; 30–45% unit cost reduction with batching + KV cache vs naive serving."

maya: love the numbers. ops question — do we have a 3rd party benchmark or internal lab? we should surface methodology.

ops-bot: benchmark-note: internal lab runs on g4dn-equivalent. latency measured over 10k requests, p95 reported.

nilesh: inbound routing: SDR asks that leads coming from Hosted CTA go to nurture flow (Marketing Qualified) while Dedicated and Private leads go to AE queue directly (sales high-touch). We need hidden form fields to capture "mode_interest" and "benchmark_event_rsvp".

maya: routing config suggestion (short):
mode_interest=hosted -> lead_queue=mar_nurture
mode_interest=dedicated -> lead_queue=ae_queue_high
mode_interest=private -> lead_queue=ae_queue_high
benchmark_event_rsvp=true -> tag=benchmark_rsvp

devon: copy tweak for form microcopy:
- Hosted form subhead: "Start with free credits — no infra changes."
- Dedicated form subhead: "Get capacity guarantees and isolation for production workloads."
- Private form subhead: "VPC & on-prem options for regulated data."

lee: also propose a small inline comparison table on the landing page with 3 rows: Performance (latency), Cost (per-token uplift), Compliance. Short bullets.

sam: webinar CTA placement: pin near hosted hero for trial signups and near Dedicated/Private blocks for AE invites. We should A/B test phrase: 'Join live demo' vs 'Watch benchmark replay'.

maya: timeline: finish copy + visuals by EOD. Devon, make final microcopy pass and push as a doc link. Lee, mockup two hero treatments. Nilesh, confirm hidden field names with HubSpot and SDR queue mapping. Sam, finalize benchmark footnote wording.

devon: will push doc: https://docs.google.com/XXX (wip) — will update with final CTAs.

lee: mockups posted in Figma: https://figma.com/file/yyy — two hero frames labeled A/B.

nilesh: confirmed with ops: hidden fields will be mode_interest & benchmark_event_rsvp. mapping to queues set. Will run a test submit later today.

sam: benchmark footnote draft: 'Internal lab, 10k requests, g4dn-equivalent hardware; results vary by model and prompt.'

maya: perfect. closing notes: keep language friendly to engineers but clear for procurement too. i'll consolidate and send PR to web repo when all assets are up. :rocket:

ops-bot: deploy-checker: please remember to add UTM params for all CTA links (utm_source=site, utm_campaign=tri-mode-launch).

maya: noted. thanks everyone — meeting if needed at 4pm.
